description: R4 requires totals to 'sum only net_worth_src==="chain"' (and earned_mo_usd only earn_src==="chain"). The implementation instead uses isVerified(src) = src !== 'unverified', which returns TRUE for rows whose *_src is ABSENT (never enriched). Those rows' SELF-ASSERTED net_worth_usd / revenue_mo_usd are then summed into the served totals. This is the exact fake-money channel INV-NOFAKE exists to close: a raw self-reported figure is trusted whenever enrichment has not run. Note dashboard-sync.js:14 serves aggregate(rawRows) with NO src fields, so the LIVE total_net_worth_usd it emits is a sum of self-asserted balances rather than the R4-mandated 'undefined (—)'. If isVerified required src==='chain', the un-enriched live endpoint would correctly emit undefined instead of a fake sum. aggregate.test.js:12-16 cements the wrong behavior by asserting total_net_worth_usd===150 from rows that carry no net_worth_src at all.

evidence.snippet: function isVerified(src) { return src !== "unverified"; } // absent counts
